prompt:
Research the officially documented free tier of Cloudflare R2 (storage, Class A and Class B operations, egress). Cite Cloudflare's documentation and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on Cloudflare's official documentation, the free tier for R2 includes specific allowances for storage, operations, and egress. It is important to note that these free allowances apply exclusively to the **Standard** storage class and do not apply to Infrequent Access storage.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "The free tier only applies to Standard storage, and does not apply to Infrequent Access storage." | CLAIM: The free tier allowances are restricted to the Standard storage class.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Storage | 10 GB-month / month" | CLAIM: The free tier includes 10 GB-months of Standard storage per month.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Class A Operations | 1 million requests / month" | CLAIM: The free tier includes 1 million Class A operations per month.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Class B Operations | 10 million requests / month" | CLAIM: The free tier includes 10 million Class B operations per month.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Egress (data transfer to Internet) | Free 1" | CLAIM: There are no charges for egress bandwidth (data transfer to the Internet) within the free tier or generally for R2.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/index.md | QUOTE: "Egressing directly from R2, including via the Workers API, S3 API, and r2.dev domains does not incur data transfer (egress) charges and is free." | CLAIM: Egress is free regardless of the method used to access the data (Workers, S3 API, etc.).

Additionally, certain operations are always free and do not count against the Class A or Class B limits.

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Free operations include `DeleteObject`, `DeleteBucket` and `AbortMultipartUpload`." | CLAIM: Delete and abort operations are exempt from operation counts and charges.
